ex.en: There were many delicious snacks at the party.
ex.zh: 派對上有很多好吃的點心。

ex.en: I had instant noodles as a midnight snack.
ex.zh: 我吃泡麵當宵夜。

ex.en: I never used to eat snacks.
ex.zh: 我以前從不吃零食。

ex.en: Do we have anything I can snack on?
ex.zh: 我們有什麼可以讓我當零食吃的嗎？

ex.en: Try not to snack between meals.
ex.zh: 盡量不要在正餐之間吃零食。

ex.en: According to the weather forecast, tomorrow will be snowy.
ex.zh: 根據氣象預報，明天會下雪。

ex.en: It's snowy today.
ex.zh: 今天下雪。

ex.en: We drove carefully on the snowy road.
ex.zh: 我們在積雪的路上小心開車。

ex.en: Look at that mountain which is covered with snow.
ex.zh: 看那座被雪覆蓋的山。

ex.en: This year we had more snow than last year.
ex.zh: 今年的雪下得比去年多。

ex.en: It snowed for ten days in a row.
ex.zh: 連續下了十天的雪。

ex.en: It hardly ever snows here in the winter.
ex.zh: 這裡冬天幾乎不下雪。

ex.en: When I opened the curtains, it was snowing.
ex.zh: 我拉開窗簾時，外面正在下雪。

ex.en: The B4 and D-sharp-5 strings snapped.
ex.zh: B4 和升 D5 的弦斷了。

ex.en: The branch snapped under his weight.
ex.zh: 樹枝被他壓得啪一聲斷了。

ex.en: Sorry, I didn't mean to snap at you.
ex.zh: 抱歉，我不是故意對你發脾氣的。

ex.en: Don't snap at me; I'm only trying to help.
ex.zh: 別對我兇，我只是想幫忙。

ex.en: Tourists were snapping photos of the temple.
ex.zh: 遊客們紛紛為寺廟拍照。

ex.en: I snapped a quick picture with my phone.
ex.zh: 我用手機很快拍了一張照片。

ex.en: A cold snap spread across Europe.
ex.zh: 一股寒流侵襲歐洲。

ex.en: We had a cold snap in early spring.
ex.zh: 初春時來了一波寒流。

ex.en: Don't make a snap decision about the offer.
ex.zh: 別倉促決定是否接受這個工作機會。

ex.en: I had to make a snap judgment.
ex.zh: 我必須當機立斷。

ex.en: He told me that he wasn't scared of snakes.
ex.zh: 他跟我說他不怕蛇。

ex.en: He's not at all afraid of snakes.
ex.zh: 他一點都不怕蛇。

ex.en: The mere thought of a snake makes me shiver.
ex.zh: 光是想到蛇就讓我發抖。

ex.en: The road snakes through the mountains.
ex.zh: 這條路在山間蜿蜒。

ex.en: A long line snaked around the building.
ex.zh: 長長的人龍繞著大樓排隊。

ex.en: I can't stop sneezing.
ex.zh: 我一直打噴嚏停不下來。

ex.en: Cover your mouth when you cough, sneeze, or yawn.
ex.zh: 咳嗽、打噴嚏或打哈欠時要遮住嘴巴。

ex.en: She let out a loud sneeze.
ex.zh: 她打了一個很大的噴嚏。

ex.en: I felt a sneeze coming on.
ex.zh: 我覺得快要打噴嚏了。

ex.en: The dog sniffed the bag at the airport.
ex.zh: 狗在機場嗅了嗅那個袋子。

ex.en: She sniffed the milk to see if it was fresh.
ex.zh: 她聞了聞牛奶看還新不新鮮。

ex.en: Stop sniffing and use a tissue.
ex.zh: 別再吸鼻子了，用面紙吧。

ex.en: He kept sniffing because of his cold.
ex.zh: 他因為感冒一直吸鼻子。

ex.en: Our auditors sniffed out several errors.
ex.zh: 我們的稽核人員查出了好幾個錯誤。

ex.en: Reporters quickly sniffed out the story.
ex.zh: 記者很快就嗅到了這則新聞。

ex.en: Tom sneaked up behind Mary.
ex.zh: 湯姆偷偷溜到瑪麗身後。

ex.en: David decided to sneak into the kitchen and find something delicious to eat.
ex.zh: 大衛決定偷偷溜進廚房，找點好吃的吃。

ex.en: She sneaked a look at her phone during class.
ex.zh: 她上課時偷偷看了一下手機。
